newsitem.title: USA: US' Summers says all freedoms key to Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: US' Summers says all freedoms key to Hong Kong.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Monday there should be no firewalls between economic and other freedoms in Hong Kong after China takes control of the British colony in July.

Speaking to a dinner sponsored by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, Summers said he was convinced that Hong Kong's awesome achievements in the economic and trade area were a reflection of the other freedoms that the colony enjoyed.
"The crucial thing to recognise for Hong Kong going forward is that there are no firewalls between economic freedom and freedom in its many other dimensions," Summers told the group.
He said the success of Hong Kong and its position in the global economy could only be maintained with the maintenance of the free flow of information and of ideas.
